invariants.rationale: actors is the main collection being traversed and is not expected to be null entering the method.
bestCoords is used for coordinate comparison and updated in the method, so it should be non-null on entry.
currentCoords is used for coordinate comparison, so it must be non-null at method entry.
Array.size is always non-negative in libGDX Array implementation.
If best is set, bestCoords must be non-null to hold its position; otherwise, it may be null.
